0022600218.text: The New York Knicks (6-4, 4th in the East, on a four-game winning streak) host the Cleveland Cavaliers (5-6, 7th in the East, on a two-game losing streak) in New York's 11th game of the season, with the Knicks 4-2 at home and the Cavaliers 1-4 on the road. Josh Hart is out for New York with illness, and Cleveland will be without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow). The Knicks lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 109-97 win in Cleveland on November 7, and they also won the 2025-26 regular season series 2-1 and the 2025-26 playoffs series 4-0.
